description:
Start a new property listing in YOUR agency's CRM from a description.
Use when the agent is describing a property they have taken on and
wants it in the system.

Creates a DRAFT. It is never published and never appears on the
portal from here: the agent adds photographs and the energy rating
in the CRM and publishes it themselves. The response includes a
direct link to the draft.

Location is resolved against the real area tree, so a town,
suburb or urbanisation name is enough. Requires a linked
PropertyList account (or an agency API key).

Commercial premises take a commercial property_type (office, shop,
retail, bar, restaurant, warehouse, garage, storage-room,
building, commercial-land...), no bedrooms, and their own facts:
usable area, the activity licence, a sale's tenure (freehold, or
traspaso: the lease and the business taken over, with the rent and
years left on the lease), a letting's guarantee, minimum term and
VAT. They are checked as the CRM checks them.

activity_licence.description: Commercial only: the activity licence (licencia de actividad): none, in_progress or granted.

ceiling_height_m.description: Commercial only: ceiling height in metres.

current_use.description: Commercial only: what the premises are used as now.

description.description: The property description, in the language the agent wrote it.

extra_guarantee_months.description: Commercial letting only: months of extra guarantee asked.

floor.description: The floor a flat or a unit (office, shop, garage, storage room) is on; 0 is the ground floor.

frontage_m.description: Commercial only: street frontage in metres.

headline.description: Short headline for the listing. Optional.

language.description: Language the description is written in. Defaults to the agency language.

lease_years_left.description: Traspaso only: years left on the lease.

licensed_activity.description: Commercial only: the activity the licence is for.

location.description: Town, suburb or urbanisation, e.g. "Nueva Andalucia" or "Menara Beach".

minimum_lease_months.description: Commercial letting only: the minimum lease term in months.

price.description: Asking price in euros, or monthly rent for a rental.

property_type.description: A home: apartment, villa, penthouse, townhouse, country-house or plot. Commercial premises: office, business, cafe, bar, restaurant, retail (premises, a local comercial), shop, hotel, leisure, industrial, warehouse, commercial-land, garage, storage-room or building.

rent_vat_applicable.description: Commercial letting only: VAT is added to the rent.

search_type.description: Whether it is for sale or for long-term rent. Defaults to for-sale.

tenure.description: Commercial sales only: freehold, or traspaso (the lease and the business are taken over).

traspaso_monthly_rent.description: Traspaso only: the monthly rent the buyer takes over, in euros.

usable_sqm.description: Commercial only: usable floor area in square metres.

name: create_listing

location.description: Where the draft was filed; null when the place name matched no area.

url.description: The draft in the CRM, where the agent finishes and publishes it.

warning.description: Advice to pass on to the agent before they publish.

title: Create listing draft
